newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL'S PELE BECOMES FATHER OF TWINS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL'S PELE BECOMES FATHER OF TWINS.

text.p: Former Brazilian soccer superstar Pele became the father of twins, a boy and a girl, Saturday night, a spokeswoman for the Sao Luiz hospital in Sao Paulo said on Sunday.

The twins, Joshua and Celeste, were born at just over 30 weeks and each weighed just under three pounds (1.30 kg). Doctors had been planning to deliver the babies after Oct. 5 but carried out the emergency Cesarian operation after Pele's wife began to feel pains, the spokeswoman said.
Both mother, whose name was not given, and babies are doing well, she added.
Pele was at the birth, the first time despite having three children from his first marriage.
"I saw everything. I cried more than the children did," Pele, aged 55 and now Brazil's Special Sports Minister, told local Globo television.
"With the World Cup matches, I've had some moments in my life but I've never experienced anything like this until now," he added.
